# Daniele Perotti
Builder and Operator · Amsterdam
I help ambitious companies build what they need next: shaping strategy, capturing new sources of growth, strengthening execution and building high-performing leadership teams.

## About me
At Rocket Internet I moved to Singapore to launch Zalora's marketplace from zero, then rolled it out across Global Fashion Group. At Booking.com I incubated four new businesses, then led a division of 300+ people with full P&L.
The work I've loved most had three things in common: the energy, the complexity, the learning. Since January 2026 I have worked independently with scale-ups, because that is where I find all three again.
I've been obsessively focused on what AI changes in how a company runs, and the edge it gives the leaders who get there first. All my work runs on my second brain OS and my businesses run on agents I build. Before that, I embedded AI at scale at Booking.com. So I know what holds up in daily operations and what only works in a demo.

### How I lead
I lead by cutting through complexity and holding vision and strategy together. The vision is the big picture and what customers need. The strategy is how we get there: plan, systems, people. This brings to life a culture of energy and engagement, where we create value for the business by creating value for the customer.

### Beyond work
I explore the world through travel, art and music, my constant sources of energy and inspiration. I also care about fitness and wellbeing, especially the ways mindfulness and technology can shape healthier lives.
Building the future starts with making sense of the now.

## Where I come in
For fifteen years I built and ran digital businesses inside the companies that took e-commerce and travel marketplaces to global market leadership. Today I do the same work with scale-ups, beside the founder: new sources of growth, an operating system that scales, and the leaders to run it.
“Making sense of the now” means holding the big picture and the detail that decides it at the same time. That is what turns a founder's vision into clear execution. I operate as a partner and an insider, and what we build together keeps growing long after I've left.

### For founders and CEOs
When every decision still comes to you, when growth has slowed and the fixes tried so far haven't joined up, or when a second business has to be built without starving the first.

### For the funds behind them
When a portfolio company stalls after a round, when a founder needs a leadership team before the next one, or when a company opens a new market or a second line of business.

## Four problems I'm brought in for
They are usually connected. Together, we decide where to start and which one to focus on.

### Where to focus, and what to build next
01 · Strategy and transformation
It isn't clear where to focus or what to build next, or a new phase is starting and the team isn't steering by the same number. Often it means a new business built beside the core.
- A clear view of today's business
- Vision, mission and values
- Launching a new line of business
- Strategy, turned into action
- Priorities, and how success is measured
> “Working across functions and markets, he held the strategic picture and the operational detail at once, building teams obsessed with high standards and high-paced delivery.”
  Alessandro Durì, co-founder of Pemo. We built drop-shipping across Southeast Asia together at Zalora.

### A product customers come back to
02 · Product experience and customer centricity
The product is drifting away from its customers. Competitors move first, customers leave without warning, and product and engineering pull in different directions.
- Knowing the competition
- Customer needs: retention and churn
- The product vision
- The product strategy
- Tech architecture and capabilities
> “The collaboration was a fantastic two year journey that had a huge impact on the direction of the company and the clarity of what we built. Dani continues to be a trusted advisor I can go to for vision and direct feedback.”
  Molly Stevens, Chief Product Officer at Amplify.One. We defined Booking.com's three-year vision together.

### Growth that moves again
03 · Growth and profitability
Growth has stalled or costs too much. Supply, go-to-market, new markets or margins aren't keeping up, and money goes into AI with no clear return.
- Scaling supply
- Building the go-to-market
- Expanding internationally
- Improving margins
- Efficiency through AI
> “Dani stays receptive to every idea while still making the tough calls. When it comes to follow-through, decision-making, and removing blockers, there’s no one more dependable.”
  Miranda Slayter, Principal UX Designer at Booking.com.

### A company that runs without the founder in every decision
04 · Organization design and governance
A strong founder with no leadership team below them, an organization shaped by its history, and key knowledge in a few people's heads.
- Building the leadership team
- Designing the organization
- Decision principles and leadership behaviors
- Governance and systems
- Board and investor reporting
> “Daniele is an amazing leader – he has a rare combination of excellent problem solving skills and a very strong ability to care for and develop the team.”
  Fridtjof Berge, co-founder of Antler. We set up Global Fashion Group's marketplace division together in 2015.

## How we work
- 1 We agree where to start We start from the problem, if it is already clear. If it isn't, we look at the company as a whole: how it makes money, how it runs, who leads it, and where the product is going. We then decide together which of the four problems comes first, and the result we are after. 01 Strategy and transformation 02 Product experience and customer centricity 03 Growth and profitability 04 Organization design and governance
- 2 We build what comes next We work side by side, inside your company. We put in place the operating system I have set up in each area I've led: one mission, the few numbers that matter, the right people. We choose those people together, and we build with them.
- 3 We ensure it keeps growing We measure everything by the result: faster execution, better outcomes for customers, revenue growth, and teams that deliver. We end up with infrastructure that lasts and growth that compounds.

### My promise
I bring calm and clarity when the stakes are high, so the right decisions get made. I'm always honest about what I see, because I care about us succeeding together. I push for the result, so the work shows up in your numbers. I build with your people, so they come out stronger.
